newsitem.title: EU: EP Budgetary Committee agenda - July 1-2.
newsitem.headline: EP Budgetary Committee agenda - July 1-2.

text.p: Committee on Budgetary Control
[[ Tuesday 01 July 1997 ]]
===] Tuesday, 1 July 1997 at 3 p.m.
1. Adoption of draft agenda (PE223.142 )
2. Approval of minutes of meeting of: - 7 April 1997 in Strasbourg (PE221.922 )
3. Chairman's announcements
4. Decision on procedure
4.1 The Union's financial framework after 1999, prospects for enlargement and analysis of the EU's financial system (T05142) F BUDG Fond R GIANSILY Jean-Antoin (UPE)
4.2 Opinion for the Committee on Institutional Affairs concerning the Treaty of Amsterdam
4.3 A Union policy against corruption (communication) (T05530) COS0571 COM(97)0192 C4-0273/97 + CONT Avis F LIBE Fond R BONTEMPI Rinaldo. (PSE)
5. Meeting with the European Court of Auditors

5.1 In the presence of Mr FRIEDMANN, President of the Court of Auditors - Requests for contributions by the Court as part of the 1995 discharge and in connection with other issues - Exchange of views on IGC
5.2 In the presence of Mr FRIEDMANN and Mr WIGGINS - Assessment, outlook and procedures regarding the SOA - Exchange of views on the basis of a working document by Mr Wynn (PE223.143 )

5.3 In the presence of Mr ENGWIRDA - Presentation of special report no 4/97: reunification of Germany (EAGGF) - member responsible: Mr GARRIGA POLLEDO - Exchange of views and procedural decision - Presentation of Special Report No 5/97: Community trade in cereals Presentation du rapport special no. 5/97: echanges communautaires de cereales - Member responsible: Mr GIANSILY - Exchange of views and procedural decision
6. Implementation of 1997 budget - COMMISSION - Rapporteur: Laurens Jan BRINKHORST - Transfer no 11/97 - EAGGF (SEC/97 1032 fin)

7. The powers and obligations of agents authorized by the Commission (Article 18(2) and (3), Regulation No 1552/89) (T05375) CNS97016 COM(96)0717 C4-0067/97 + CONT Fond R BARDONG Otto. (PPE) (PE222.173 ) - Exchange of views and - Adoption of draft report
===] Wednesday 2 July 1997 at 9 a.m.
8. Implementation of 1997 budget - Other institutions - Rapporteur: Juan Manuel FABRA VALLES
8.1 Request for transfer of appropriations C3 - Parliament (miscellaneous expenditure on equipment and financing costs) (PE222.176 )
8.2 Request for transfer of appropriations C4 (implications of judgment by Court of Justice in the DE COMPTE case) (PE222.177 )
8.3 Request for transfer of appropriations 12/97 - Court of Justice (SEC/97 1034fin)
9. Special Report No 1/96 on the MED Programmes (T05001) COS0462 RAP CC 1/96S C4-0512/96 + CONT Fond R FABRA VALLES J. (PPE) (PE221.924/REV) - Adoption of draft report
10. Financial control of Structural Funds (T05526) COS0567 C4-246/97 C4-0246/97 + CONT Fond COLOM I N. (PSE) (PE222.175 ) - Adoption of draft report
11. Any other business
12. Date of next meeting (PE/XVI/OJ/97-18 ) - FIN - END OF DOCUMENT.
